name: EH3D-STUDIO
stack: React 19, TypeScript and Vite; served by EH3D-SERVER
build: npm ci && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.5: the configuration panel of EH3D-SERVER, in the look of EH3D-BUNGARD-GUI (the Forge theme) and organised in three groups: Monitor (overview, machines by station, jobs, live events), Configure (machines with their node and their configuration files, users and tokens, the settings of the server) and Account (password, language, theme). Eight languages. It talks only to the API of the server and the server can serve its pages at the root of its own address. The client of the API, the rules of the forms and the eight languages are tested; the pages have been looked at in a browser against a local server with simulated machines, and not against machines on a bench.
